description: This file contains the implementation of the HTTP/1.x protocol layer for a web server, including functions for sending responses, processing request headers and body, handling timeouts, and connection management.

methods.name: int h1_send_1xx_info(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Sends a 1xx informational HTTP response, handling partial writes and error conditions.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_send_1xx(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a 1xx response, including headers and optional status line.

methods.name: int h1_send_100_continue(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Sends a 100 Continue response if appropriate.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void h1_send_headers_partial_1xx(request_st * const r,buffer * const b)
methods.description: Transfers queued headers from connection write queue into a buffer for sending prior to final response headers.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ chunk * h1_discard_blank_line(chunkqueue * const cq,uint32_t header_len)
methods.description: Discards a blank line in headers, marking data as written.

methods.name: chunk * h1_recv_headers_more(connection * const con,chunkqueue * const cq,chunk * c,const size_t olen)
methods.description: Reads more header data from the connection, handling continuation and connection upgrades.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_check_upgrade(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Checks and handles protocol upgrade headers, e.g., to HTTP/2 or WebSocket.

methods.name: int h1_recv_headers(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Parses incoming request headers, handling pipelining, header size limits, and protocol detection.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ int h1_check_expect_100(request_st * const r,connection * const con)
methods.description: Checks for Expect: 100-continue header and sends interim response if needed.

methods.name: int h1_cq_compact(chunkqueue * const cq)
methods.description: Attempts to merge adjacent memory chunks in the chunkqueue to optimize memory usage.

methods.name: __attribute_pure__ int h1_chunked_crlf(chunkqueue * const cq)
methods.description: Validates chunked transfer encoding CRLF endings in chunked data.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int h1_chunked_400_bad_request(request_st * const r,const char * errstr)
methods.description: Handles errors related to invalid chunked encoding, returning HTTP 400.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ int h1_chunked_trailers(request_st * const restrict r,char * restrict t,uint32_t tlen)
methods.description: Processes trailers in chunked request bodies.

methods.name: int h1_chunked(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,chunkqueue * const dst_cq)
methods.description: Processes chunked-encoded request bodies, handling trailer detection and size limits.

methods.name: int h1_read_body_unknown(request_st * const r,chunkqueue * const cq,chunkqueue * const dst_cq)
methods.description: Reads request body data when content length is unknown, with size limits.

methods.name: handler_t h1_reqbody_read(request_st * const r)
methods.description: Handles reading and processing the request body, supporting chunked and fixed-length bodies.

methods.name: int h1_check_timeout(connection * const con,const unix_time64_t cur_ts)
methods.description: Checks and enforces connection timeouts such as keep-alive and read/write idle timeouts.
